title: Reverse-skill: Free AI-Powered Reverse Engineering Router for Security Researchers
description:
Reverse-skill is a free, self-hosted alternative to IDA Pro that routes your AI agent through the right reverse-engineering and security testing workflows. It automatically picks the right methodology, checks installed tools, and runs a repeatable workflow for APKs, binaries, CTF challenges, and more. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI clients.
